topic: Advanced past simple, past continuous and past perfect
task: Write one word in each gap: Last night the smoke alarm ___ off as soon as he ___ the candle underneath it. (go / light)
explanation shown to learner: Two completed events that follow one another: past simple for both (*went off as soon as he lit*). The continuous would mean that one was in progress when the other happened.
explanation in Latvian: Divi pabeigti notikumi, kas seko viens otram: abiem Past Simple (*went off as soon as he lit*). Continuous forma nozīmētu, ka viens jau notika, kad notika otrs.

topic: Advanced past simple, past continuous and past perfect
correct answer: We were flying to Oslo four times last year.
wrong options / checks: While my car was being repaired, I was cycling to work. | When the builders were here, I was making them tea all day. | She dropped her keys while she was getting out of the taxi.
explanation shown to learner: With a count of repeated actions (*four times last year*), use the past simple: *We flew to Oslo four times.* The continuous is possible for repeated actions in a limited, temporary period (*While my car was being repaired, I was cycling*).
explanation in Latvian: Ja atkārtotas darbības saskaita (*four times last year*), lieto Past Simple: *We flew to Oslo four times.* Continuous forma iespējama atkārtotām darbībām īslaicīgā periodā (*While my car was being repaired, I was cycling*).

topic: Advanced past simple, past continuous and past perfect
task: As soon as I saw her at the party, I was sure we ___ before. (meet)
explanation shown to learner: *I was sure* is in the past, and the meeting was earlier still: past perfect, *we had met before* (not *we met*).
explanation in Latvian: *I was sure* ir pagātnē, un tikšanās bija vēl agrāk: Past Perfect, *we had met before* (nevis *we met*).

topic: Advanced past simple, past continuous and past perfect
task: By the time Sam and I started working together, we ___ each other for ten years. (know)
explanation shown to learner: *know* is a state verb: past perfect simple, *had known*, not *had been knowing*.
explanation in Latvian: *know* ir stāvokļa darbības vārds: Past Perfect Simple, *had known*, nevis *had been knowing*.

topic: Advanced past simple, past continuous and past perfect
task: His voice was hoarse because he ___ all afternoon at the match. (shout)
correct answer: had been shouting | 'd been shouting | had shouted | 'd shouted
explanation shown to learner: The shouting was over and explains how his voice was later: past perfect continuous, *had been shouting* (not *was shouting*).
explanation in Latvian: Kliegšana jau bija beigusies un izskaidro, kāda vēlāk bija viņa balss: Past Perfect Continuous, *had been shouting* (nevis *was shouting*).
answer notes: had shouted :: Also possible; the continuous shows better that the shouting went on all afternoon. :: Arī pareizi; Continuous forma labāk parāda, ka kliegšana turpinājās visu pēcpusdienu.

topic: Advanced past simple, past continuous and past perfect
task: Choose the correct option: When I got back to my desk, I could see that someone ___ my files.
wrong options / checks: has moved | had been moved | is moving
explanation shown to learner: A conclusion about something that happened before a past moment (*when I got back*): past perfect, *someone had moved my files*.
explanation in Latvian: Secinājums par to, kas notika pirms pagātnes brīža (*when I got back*): Past Perfect, *someone had moved my files*.

topic: Advanced past simple, past continuous and past perfect
task: These shoes are too small and the shop won't take them back. I wish I ___ the receipt. (keep)
explanation shown to learner: A regret about the past: *I wish* + past perfect, *I wish I had kept the receipt*. *I wish I kept* would be about the present.
explanation in Latvian: Nožēla par pagātni: *I wish* + Past Perfect, *I wish I had kept the receipt.* *I wish I kept* būtu par tagadni.

topic: Advanced past simple, past continuous and past perfect
correct answer: We have hoped the weather would hold, but it rained all weekend.
wrong options / checks: I was meaning to call you, but the week got away from me. | I had hoped to finish the report by Friday. | They were planning to move, but they changed their minds.
explanation shown to learner: A hope or a plan that did not happen, about the past: past perfect, past simple or past continuous (*We had hoped / hoped / were hoping*), not the present perfect (*have hoped*): the weekend is over.
explanation in Latvian: Cerība vai plāns, kas neīstenojās, par pagātni: Past Perfect, Past Simple vai Past Continuous (*We had hoped / hoped / were hoping*), nevis Present Perfect (*have hoped*): nedēļas nogale ir beigusies.

topic: Advanced past simple, past continuous and past perfect
task: I went back to my old school last summer and found that it ___ much. (not / change)
correct answer: hadn't changed | had not changed | hasn't changed | has not changed
explanation shown to learner: What you found at a past moment about the time before it: past perfect, *it hadn't changed much* (not *didn't change*).
explanation in Latvian: Ko konstatēji pagātnes brīdī par laiku pirms tā: Past Perfect, *it hadn't changed much* (nevis *didn't change*).
answer notes: hasn't changed :: Also possible: the school is still the same now, so the present perfect is fine; the past perfect is the form after *found* (a moment in the past). :: Arī pareizi: skola joprojām ir tāda pati, tāpēc der Present Perfect; aiz *found* (pagātnes brīdis) parasti lieto Past Perfect.

topic: Advanced past simple, past continuous and past perfect
task: By the time the doctor arrived, the patient ___ for over an hour. (wait)
correct answer: had been waiting | 'd been waiting | had waited | 'd waited
explanation shown to learner: An activity that went on up to a past moment (*by the time the doctor arrived*): past perfect continuous, *had been waiting*.
explanation in Latvian: Darbība, kas turpinājās līdz pagātnes brīdim (*by the time the doctor arrived*): Past Perfect Continuous, *had been waiting*.
answer notes: had waited :: Also possible; the continuous shows better that the waiting went on until the doctor came. :: Arī pareizi; Continuous forma labāk parāda, ka gaidīšana turpinājās līdz ārsta ierašanās brīdim.

topic: Advanced past simple, past continuous and past perfect
task: We drove all the way there for nothing. I wish you ___ me the restaurant was closed on Mondays. (tell)
explanation shown to learner: A wish about the past: *I wish* + past perfect, *I wish you had told me*.
explanation in Latvian: Vēlēšanās par pagātni: *I wish* + Past Perfect, *I wish you had told me.*
